description: Update an existing payment. Only supplied fields change. startDate and endDate cover whole months; when only one is supplied, the existing other bound is reused. Setting status to COMPLETED generates a receipt number when needed. cashBox moves a CASH payment in or out of the building cash box. Setting status to CANCELLED stores an optional cancelReason that appears in the audit log and the apartment ledger.

cancelReason.description: Why the payment was cancelled. Supply it together with status CANCELLED; it is stored on the payment and shown in the audit log and the apartment ledger.

cashBox.description: True when the money sits in the building cash box. Only meaningful for CASH payments; storing false for any other method keeps it out of the cash box.

name: update_payment
title: Update payment
